name: mrhodes
description: Mason Rhodes's Claude Code plugins, one catalog; each plugin lives in its own repository

plugins.name: needs-you
plugins.description: Claude ends every turn with a typed 'What I need from you' list; answer it from a band above the prompt and the answers send themselves

plugins.name: pm-loop
plugins.description: Event-driven, script-first PM loop for GitHub repos worked by Claude Code lanes: poller/webhook → queue → one small headless PM tick; scripted pre-merge/merge, STATUS entries, fact-checks, review routing; fresh capped agents; local LLM for prose only.
